name: Mandate Adjustment 1
definition: Specifies the details for the adjustment of the mandate.

DateAdjustmentRuleIndicator.name: Date Adjustment Rule Indicator
DateAdjustmentRuleIndicator.definition: Specifies whether an adjustment is to be applied on pre-agreed collection date or not.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Pre-agreed amount to increase or decrease the mandate amount as justified per information in the category.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Pre-agreed increase or decrease rate that will be applied to the collection amount.
